sources.notes: Primary pp139–144 and Plate7/8 photographs. Plate8.3 RM Ec3304 E.aurantium aurantium, N.Freberga Sweden: four brachiole facets, gonopore. Plate7.3 RM Ec3677 and7.5 RM Ec4015 are exterior thecae, latter anal pyramid inked; do not interpret ink as unaltered skeletal pixel. Plate7.6 and8.4 are INTERNAL MOULDS, excluded as exterior ornament. Plate8.2 RM Ec5316 mutation supra has FOUR anal valves; do not transplant to nominate Swedish form whose five anal valves are primary text supported. Smooth epithek covers pore canals; many hundreds of unequal plates, fine stem usually absent from fossils. Mouth slit inferred in original text, detailed pavement unresolved. No exact brachiole branching retained on RM Ec3304.
